title: slot_hash uses wrong algorithm (XOR vs ADD)
description:
File: python/src/lichen/ccp.py:284

slot_hash uses XOR formula but spec section 14.7 and test vectors require ADD formula: (hash_32(EUI64) + SFN) % num_slots.

**Failure scenario:** For EUI64=0x0102030405060708, SFN=4294967295, num_slots=16: code returns slot 1, but ccp_sfn_wrap_slot_hash.json expects slot 12. Causes TDMA slot misassignment breaking network synchronization.

**Verdict:** CONFIRMED
